Clustering: Start-ordered greedy complete-link; all pairs in a group pass. No averaging.

Metrics.CompleteStrategies: Maximum absolute difference over complete action vector including off-path information sets
Metrics.ReachedBehavior: Total variation of joint observed decision histories, summing omitted truth/court copies
Metrics.Outcomes: Maximum absolute difference over all unrounded exported metrics and five monetary welfare measures in native units; null differs from number

Caveat: Descriptive numerical grouping, not exact equivalence or enumeration of all equilibria. Recovery frequencies are not litigant selection probabilities.
